summary: The LLM bridge provider-settings feature is implemented, verified, security-reviewed, release-documented, and archived for source handoff. The current web app can configure provider keys through FastAPI /api/llm proxy routes, activate a provider/model, report truthful llm-bridge readiness, and run pipeline stages through the local bridge driver.
delivered: Local Bun/TypeScript llm_bridge service with provider registry, persisted provider config, active provider/model selection, health, provider test, generate, stream, typecheck, and regression test coverage.
Python appforge.llm_bridge standard-library HTTP client plus FastAPI /api/llm proxy routes so the browser remains same-origin.
LLMBridgeDriver and driver aliases llm-bridge, llm_bridge, and llm wired through appforge.drivers.create_driver.
JobManager readiness checks that require bridge reachability, active provider selection, and configured provider state before APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge is marked ready.
Vue ProviderSettings modal integrated into TopBar/App, with API helpers, shared TypeScript types, styling, provider save/delete/test/activate flows, and packaged production web assets.
Security hardening: bridge provider upsert no longer echoes raw saved provider config or API keys, and bridge responses no longer advertise wildcard CORS.
Archive hardening: source archiver now ignores .appforge-web, projects, *.egg-info directories, and .DS_Store files; tests cover these exclusions.
Documentation updates in README.md, docs/WEB_APP.md, and CHANGELOG.md for bridge startup, configuration variables, wheel/source behavior, rollback, and known limitations.
Release artifacts: dist/openappforge-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl and dist/openappforge-0.4.0.tar.gz rebuilt from final source.
quickstart: Start the bridge: cd llm_bridge && bun install && bun run start
Start the web app with the bridge driver from the repository root: APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge .venv/bin/appforge web
Open http://127.0.0.1:8787, open Provider Settings, save or rely on a provider key, choose/test a model, and activate the provider.

Alternative CLI compatibility remains: APPFORGE_DRIVER=auto .venv/bin/appforge web, or APPFORGE_DRIVER=generic APPFORGE_AGENT_CMD='my-agent --workspace {workspace} --prompt {prompt_file}' .venv/bin/appforge web.
Rebuild frontend assets after UI changes: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
Bridge development checks: cd llm_bridge && bun run typecheck && bun run test
Production package build: env PATH=.venv/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin .venv/bin/python -m appforge tool run run_build --project . --input '{}'

operations_reference: APPFORGE_DRIVER=llm-bridge enables the bridge driver; auto, codex, claude, and generic remain supported.
APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8788 for FastAPI-to-bridge calls.
APPFORGE_LLM_PROVIDER optionally overrides the active provider; APPFORGE_MODEL optionally overrides the model.
Bridge process defaults: APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_HOST=127.0.0.1 and APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_PORT=8788.
Bridge config defaults to ~/.appforge/llm/providers.json unless APPFORGE_LLM_CONFIG_DIR or APPFORGE_LLM_CONFIG is set.
Provider keys may come from the UI or provider environment variables such as OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, and XAI_API_KEY.
Keep the web server and bridge loopback-only unless an authenticated reverse proxy, host firewall, and OS isolation are in place.
Runtime rollback: stop the bridge and set APPFORGE_DRIVER back to auto/codex/claude/generic. Provider rollback: delete provider settings in UI or remove the local bridge config file.
open_items: Live provider connectivity and provider-side authorization were not verified because no API credentials were supplied.
Online dependency audit is deferred because network downloads are disabled in this AppForge project; the local secret scan and SBOM passed.
The llm-bridge driver is single-shot per stage and does not perform CLI-agent file editing; use Codex, Claude Code, or generic command driver for fully agentic file edits.
The Python wheel includes the FastAPI proxy and packaged web UI, but the Bun llm_bridge service is a source-tree component; use the source checkout/source archive or an already-running bridge.
Setuptools license metadata deprecation warnings remain and should be cleaned up before 2027-Feb-18.
